title.zh-CN: 孕中期发热咳嗽 · 25岁女性
title.en: Fever and cough in mid-pregnancy · woman aged 25

summary.zh-CN: 孕中期患者因发热咳嗽入院，随后呼吸状况迅速变化；需核对接触史、病原证据与母胎转归。
summary.en: A patient in mid-pregnancy is admitted with fever and cough before rapid respiratory deterioration; review exposures, pathogen evidence and maternal-fetal outcomes.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例改写。保留年龄、性别和临床证据；姓名为化名，医院、日历日期、职业身份细节已去除。对话、问题、评分和安全选项为教学设计，未记录的数据明确未知。
notes.en: Adapted from a published case. Age, sex and clinical evidence are retained; names are pseudonyms and hospitals, calendar dates and identifying occupational details are removed. Dialogue, questions, scoring and safety options are educational design; missing data remain unknown.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。结果由原报告提供，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not individual care or self-medication. Outcomes come from the report; undocumented physiological changes are not simulated.

text.zh-CN: 发病第8天双肺大片模糊影；原图描述肺门旁和左下肺明显，有支气管充气征。
text.en: On illness day 8 there were extensive bilateral opacities, particularly perihilar and left lower-zone, with air bronchograms.

text.en: Nasopharyngeal testing was positive for the H7N9-specific haemagglutinin gene, confirmed by public-health laboratories.

text.zh-CN: 白细胞7.9×10⁹/L，中性粒细胞比例0.84；正文另列淋巴细胞2.8×10⁹/L，两项分类数据不自洽，按原记录保留而不校正。
text.en: WBC was 7.9×10⁹/L with neutrophil fraction 0.84; the separately reported lymphocyte count of 2.8×10⁹/L is inconsistent with that differential and is retained without correction.

text.en: Ultrasound confirmed mid-pregnancy; serial fetal-heart values and a complete obstetric examination are not provided.

text.zh-CN: 原报告采用有创肺保护通气、俯卧位、抗病毒等综合治疗，也使用免疫调节和短程激素。第20病日通过自主呼吸试验后拔管；后续病毒核酸转阴。第110病日、孕38周加4天剖宫产娩出3.3 kg女婴，报告母婴健康；未给出长期随访期限。
text.en: The report used invasive lung-protective ventilation, prone positioning, antivirals and other measures, including immunomodulation and short-course steroids. She passed a spontaneous breathing trial and was extubated on illness day 20; subsequent viral tests became negative. On illness day 110 at 38+4 weeks she delivered a 3.3 kg girl by caesarean; mother and infant were reported healthy without a defined long-term follow-up interval.

text.en: H7N9 infection with severe hypoxaemic respiratory failure/ARDS

feedback.zh-CN: 病原阳性与双肺影、极低氧合共同支持重症感染；妊娠不能淡化母体危重程度。
feedback.en: Positive pathogen testing, bilateral opacities and very poor oxygenation support severe infection; pregnancy does not diminish maternal urgency.

text.zh-CN: 普通上呼吸道感染，等待自然恢复即可
text.en: An uncomplicated upper respiratory infection needing only observation

feedback.zh-CN: 病原阳性与双肺影、极低氧合共同支持重症感染；妊娠不能淡化母体危重程度。
feedback.en: Positive pathogen testing, bilateral opacities and very poor oxygenation support severe infection; pregnancy does not diminish maternal urgency.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样在证据有限时制定下一步？

text.zh-CN: 立即重症、呼吸、感染及产科协作，评估呼吸支持、抗病毒与母胎监测
text.en: Immediate critical-care, respiratory, infection and obstetric coordination for respiratory support, antivirals and maternal-fetal monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 单例合并多种治疗不能证明每种措施的独立疗效；应由专科依当下病情和指南决策。
feedback.en: A single case with multiple concurrent therapies cannot prove each treatment’s independent effect; specialists must use the current condition and guidance.

text.zh-CN: 照搬病例中的免疫球蛋白、胸腺肽和激素组合并认定必然有效
text.en: Copy the reported immunoglobulin, thymosin and steroid combination as proven effective

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 该病例记录妊娠合并H7N9重症肺炎后母婴存活；不能从多药联用的单例推出具体辅助药物有效。
conclusion.en: This case records maternal and infant survival after severe H7N9 pneumonia in pregnancy; it cannot establish efficacy of individual adjunctive drugs.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 家禽暴露引导病原检测，核酸提供特异证据。
keyReasoning.en: Poultry exposure prompted targeted testing and PCR provided specific evidence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 无创通气后仍极差的氧合是升级评估的关键。
keyReasoning.en: Persistently severe oxygenation impairment after non-invasive support was a key reason for escalation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.

unknowns.en: Complete fetal-heart series, long-term infant development and the cause of the blood differential inconsistency.
